Statewise recovery: sealed exploratory comparison

All 238 source images were already exposed during development. PRIMARY192 = TEST49 + REMAINDER143; CAL46 is separate. This is not an independent test. The reference is existing geometric reconstruction, not independent physical ground truth. Material/cuboid owner correspondence remains unverified.

Success is center translation ≤5 cm and physical rotation ≤5° on one final pose, with C2 I/Y (180°) only; no 90° width/depth equivalence. Every frame, missing pose and tail value remains in the data. The gallery only presents sealed evaluator outputs.
